%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% config.tex
%% User configuration: add your files and settings here.
%% Do NOT edit main.tex.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%======================================================
%% Report identification
%% Edit the file "personaldataofreport.tex" for title, authors, etc.
%======================================================
\input{Config/personaldataofreport}

%======================================================
%% Hyperref metadata
%======================================================
\hypersetup{
  a4paper=true,
  pdftitle={\thetitle},
  pdfauthor={\theauthor},
  pdfsubject={},
  pdfkeywords={{},{},{}}
}

%======================================================
%% Abstract files (located in Chapters/)
%======================================================
\ptabstractfile{resumo}
\enabstractfile{abstract}

%======================================================
%% Front matter lists (comment out what you don't need)
%======================================================
\addlisttofrontmatter{\conditionalLoF}                      % List of Figures
\addlisttofrontmatter{\conditionalLoT}                      % List of Tables
\addlisttofrontmatter{\conditionalLoL}                      % List of Code Listings
\addlisttofrontmatter{\printnoidxglossary[type=acronym]}    % List of Acronyms
\addlisttofrontmatter{\printnoidxglossary}                  % Glossary

%======================================================
%% Chapters (located in Chapters/)
%% syntax: \chapterfile{filename}
%======================================================
\chapterfile{chapter1}
\chapterfile{chapter2}
\chapterfile{chapter3}

%======================================================
%% Bibliography file
%======================================================
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}

%======================================================
%% Appendixes (located in Appendixes/, comment if none)
%% syntax: \appendixfile{filename}
%======================================================
\appendixfile{appendix1}
